Type: floral print throw pillow

Style: traditional, bohemian, contemporary
Materials: printed woven cotton-look fabric
Colors: dark teal, white, pale grey-green

Feel: fresh, natural, charming
Goes with: white or cream sofas, natural wood, green plants; traditional or bohemian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Modern Floral Throw Pillow - 20 x 20 Inch, Teal
product.description: Cover: 100% polyester, Stuffing: 100% polyester Made in the United States of imported materials 20"L x 20"W Refresh your space with this updated floral pattern in modern colors. The back of the pillow is solid-colored fabric. Spot clean. Put in dryer on low heat for 20 minutes to release wrinkles, or use garment steamer. Do not iron.
